# Guides {#guides}

A guide is a page you read top to bottom to learn how to do one thing. The API Reference is where you look something up. If you know what you want to do but not which functions do it, start here.

- @subpage guide_effects - Answer the things a program asks of the terminal, such as the bell, title changes and queries.
- @subpage guide_colors - Set a theme, read colors back, parse color strings, and report light or dark mode.
- @subpage guide_scrollback - Limit history, scroll through it, draw a scrollbar, and keep its memory down.
- @subpage guide_custom_sequences - Handle sequences we don't implement, and stop a write at a string boundary.
